description.text: Introduction： This program will enable students to know about basic theory and skill of modern oil gas geological science and students can be trained as geological engineers. After graduating, students can work in the field of oil gas resource prospecting and other relative fields for engineering design, and management. Curriculum： Oral Chinese, Advanced Mathematics, Chinese Intensive Reading, A Survey of China, Geological Resource and geological Engineering, Oil Gas Geology and Prospecting, Sedimentlogy, Subsurface Geology of Oil and Gas Field. Architectonic Geology, Theory and Explanation of Seismic Prospecting.

duration.text: The Resource Prospecting Engineering at China University of Petroleum (Huadong) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
